name: Jezero Crater - western crater rim
_window_comment: Window in DEM pixel units (multiples of 3 so edges fall on 6 m ortho pixel edges). Sized from the positions of the nine crater-rim sample sites (Turquoise Bay to Singita, NASA Mars 2020 Initial Reports) plus about 1.2 km margin.

habitat.name: Hypothetical forward habitat (placed at Perseverance's position on sol 909)
habitat.note: No habitat exists on Mars. Placed at Perseverance's first recorded position inside this area (site 44, drive 4864, sol 909), on the upper fan below the crater rim.
